item.description: Parts of ancient Antioch (modern Antakya, Türkiye) were excavated from 1932 to 1939 by a team led by Princeton University. item.description: This article discusses evidence from Central Apulian necropoleis between the sixth and fourth centuries BCE to illustrate three forms of post-depositional interactions with the dead: tomb reopening for goods retrieval, the construction of residential buildings above preexisting graves, and repeated reuses of ostensibly single-deposition tombs.
